section_info.title: Upcoming Events & Seminars
section_info.subtitle: Join our interactive sessions with university delegates and experts to clear all your doubts about studying abroad.

data.title: UK Education Expo 2026
data.description: Meet representatives from 50+ UK universities directly. Get on-spot assessment, clarify entry requirements, and secure exclusive scholarship guidance for the upcoming intake.

data.title: Scholarship Webinar: Study in Canada
data.description: An intensive session covering fully-funded scholarship opportunities in Canada. Learn about the GIC process, study permit requirements, and post-graduation work permits (PGWP).

data.title: Australia University Open Day
data.description: Experience the Australian education system. Interacting with alumni and university delegates from top Group of Eight universities. Bring your academic documents for evaluation.

data.title: USA High-Ranked University Seminar
data.description: Special focus on Ivy League and high-ranked US universities. Detailed discussion on SAT/GRE requirements, Statement of Purpose (SOP) writing, and F1 Visa interview preparation.

data.title: IELTS & PTE Success Workshop
data.description: Struggling with English proficiency tests? Join our certified trainers for a masterclass on cracking IELTS/PTE in the first attempt with 7.5+ band score tips.
